items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group.terra_sg)
items.issue: Unrestricted egress to all destinations (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports/protocols)
items.remediation: Restrict egress rules to only the specific ports, protocols, and destination CIDRs required by the application. Replace the egress block's cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] and protocol = "-1" with explicit rules, e.g., allow only port 443 to specific CIDRs needed by the workload.

items.known: CKV2_AWS_11 Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs (resource aws_vpc.terra_vpc)
items.remediation: Add an aws_flow_log resource referencing this VPC. For example: resource "aws_flow_log" "terra_vpc_flow_log" { vpc_id = aws_vpc.terra_vpc.id traffic_type = "ALL" iam_role_arn = aws_iam_role.flow_log_role.arn log_destination = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.flow_log.arn }

scores.reason: Correctly targets the egress block, replacing protocol "-1" and 0.0.0.0/0 with specific ports (e.g. 443) and restricted CIDRs, which satisfies CKV_AWS_382.

Adds an aws_flow_log with vpc_id = aws_vpc.terra_vpc.id, traffic_type, iam_role_arn and log_destination. This is the standard fix for CKV2_AWS_11. The supporting IAM role and log group are referenced but not defined, which is a minor gap.
